business_summary: Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures and sells prestressed steel products in China and internationally. It offers prestressed materials comprising galvanized (aluminum) wires for bridge cables, PC strands for wind power concrete towers, prestressed galvanized (aluminum) strands for photovoltaic, unbonded galvanized strands for hydropower, strands for nuclear power plant safety shells and low temperature LNG/LPG, prestressing systems of high-speed railway track slabs, PC wires for railway sleepers and PCCP pipelines, and PC bars for t-shaped continuous beams. The company also provides prestressed concrete products for track slabs; new energy materials products, such as prestressed flexible large-span suspension photovoltaic support systems, flexible photovoltaic support prestressed anchors, and flexible photovoltaic bracket side slopes; automation equipment; and precision steel molds for track slabs, sleepers, and pipe segments. In addition, it offers project management information and intelligent monitoring systems, such as 3D displacement intelligent monitoring systems for construction engineering, seamless rail crawling monitoring systems, railway seamless rail stress release and locking construction management systems, concrete product production management systems for rail transit, PCCP water pipeline production management systems, and wind power concrete tower intelligent monitoring systems. The company serves the rail transit, highways, railways, water conservancy, new energy, construction, and other sectors. Further, it is also involved in new energy project investment; trading; technology development and technical consulting; technical services; and power generation and transmission activities. The company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Silvery Dragon Prestressed Materials Co.,LTD Tianjin and changed its name to Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin in December 2025. Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin was founded in 1978 and is based in Tianjin, China.
business_summary_ko: Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. 천진은 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 프리스트레스트 철강 제품을 연구, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 교량 케이블용 아연도금(알루미늄) 와이어, 풍력 콘크리트 타워용 PC 스트랜드, 태양광용 프리스트레스 아연도금(알루미늄) 스트랜드, 수력발전용 프리스트레스 아연도금(알루미늄) 스트랜드, 원자력 발전소 안전 쉘 및 저온 LNG/LPG용 스트랜드, 고속철도 선로 슬래브의 프리스트레싱 시스템, 철도 침목 및 PCCP 파이프라인용 PC 와이어, T자형 연속빔. 이 회사는 또한 트랙 슬래브용 프리스트레스트 콘크리트 제품도 제공합니다. 프리스트레스트 가요성 대경간 현수 태양광 지지 시스템, 가요성 태양광 지지 프리스트레스 앵커, 가요성 태양광 브래킷 측면 경사면과 같은 신에너지 소재 제품; 자동화 장비; 궤도 슬래브, 침목 및 파이프 세그먼트용 정밀 강철 금형 등이 있습니다. 또한 건설 엔지니어링을 위한 3차원 변위 지능형 모니터링 시스템, 심리스 레일 등 프로젝트 관리 정보 및 지능형 모니터링 시스템을 제공합니다.
